tokens.v: The crystal flacon stands on a deco dressing table between lit vanity bulbs, its cut facets throwing small warm stars across the walnut while the mirror behind holds a doubled, softer version of the scene. 85mm at f/2 at tabletop height: the near facets and gold dome razor sharp, elbow-length silk gloves dropped in a heap beside it, a lipstick-marked glass and an invitation card blurred at the frame's edge, cut by the right. VERLAINE surfaces acid-etched on the shoulder facet only where the bulb light rakes it. One bulb flares softly in the top-left corner; the table's edge runs out the bottom.
